AIROOM includes the unmodified Windows x64 7za.exe from 7zip-bin 5.2.0
solely to extract the verified official ZCode installer. It is a separate
executable and may be replaced with a compatible 7-Zip console build.

7-Zip 21.07, Copyright (C) 1999-2021 Igor Pavlov.
License: GNU LGPL 2.1 or later, with the additional notices in 7zip-LICENSE.txt.
The complete LGPL text is in 7zip-LGPL.txt.
The corresponding, unmodified upstream source is included as 7z2107-src.7z.
Source: https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/releases/download/21.07/7z2107-src.7z
Project: https://www.7-zip.org/

7zip-bin 5.2.0 wrapper: MIT; its license is retained in
node_modules/7zip-bin/LICENSE.txt. Non-Windows binaries are omitted.
